governance.rule: Human authority is required for pedagogical authority transitions, not for every extraction step.

classReportsV2.title: Travel narrative, supported Past Simple and immediate uptake
evidence: Gustavo generated personal travel content about France and Portugal.
The form 'I didn't go' appears after explicit teacher scaffold/recast.
buy/bought appears through immediate supported uptake.
classReportsV2.signal: Past-time forms are available with support; immediate uptake is visible, but independence is not established.
classReportsV2.interpretation: Use Gustavo's own travel narrative as a low-support test of delayed past-time retrieval.
classReportsV2.boundary: Heavy prompting is present. Immediate repetition does not prove retention or independent mastery.
classReportsV2.nextVerification: Retell a real trip/weekend with first-attempt output preserved before correction.

classReportsV2.title: School subjects, personal past-time production and question formation
evidence: School-subject vocabulary is retrieved with varying support.
Personal past-time production emerges with prompting.
Past-negative production becomes accurate in controlled practice after a model.
did + base-form question formation remains unstable.
classReportsV2.signal: Controlled past negatives are more available than irregular retrieval and did-question formation.
classReportsV2.interpretation: Separate spontaneous past statements, negative past and question formation in a lower-support task.
classReportsV2.boundary: Much of the lesson is teacher-led; reading supplied text is not spontaneous grammar evidence.
classReportsV2.nextVerification: Elicit unsupported affirmative, negative and interrogative past forms in the same meaningful context.

classReportsV2.title: Past review, health language and supported form correction
evidence: 'I go' shifts to 'I went' after correction: corrected uptake, not independent retrieval.
'didn't swim' and 'didn't eat' are preserved through teacher-read chat output.
'Did you rode?' is corrected to 'Did you ride?', confirming instability in did + base form.
'The boy has a stomach ache' is independently produced; other health items show mixed support.
should/shouldn't and superlatives are largely scaffold/model-dependent.
classReportsV2.signal: Immediate corrective uptake recurs, while first-attempt control of past questions remains unstable.
classReportsV2.interpretation: Preserve first-attempt output before teacher correction in future checks.
classReportsV2.boundary: Teacher-led test review creates substantial scaffolding; the original chat artifact is not separately preserved.
classReportsV2.nextVerification: Capture first attempt, self-correction and teacher-supported final answer as separate evidence states.

classReportsV2.title: Science review through English: supported retrieval and connected explanation
evidence: Nutrient categories and functions are retrieved with mixed support.
The digestive sequence is rehearsed with strong scaffolding.
Gustavo attempts a connected explanation of stomach and small-intestine functions.
The large-intestine/water relation is retrieved during closing questioning; small-intestine/nutrient absorption remains more cue-dependent.
classReportsV2.signal: Gustavo can reach short connected Science explanations after rehearsal, while independent transfer remains unverified.
classReportsV2.interpretation: Use a closed-book, no-model oral Science check rather than another guided review.
classReportsV2.boundary: Major audio/connectivity problems affect part of the transcript; Science knowledge and English-language independence must remain separate.
classReportsV2.nextVerification: Short closed-book explanation of nutrient functions and the digestive route with first-attempt evidence preserved.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: Past-negative forms recur under controlled/scaffolded conditions across 18 Aug, 25 Aug and 01 Sep.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: This does not establish independent mastery.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: Past-question formation with did + base form remains unstable across more than one lesson.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: The evidence supports a recurring priority, not a quantified proficiency score.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: Irregular-past retrieval is uneven and support-dependent.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: Modeled or immediately corrected forms are not treated as independent retrieval.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: Immediate uptake after teacher correction/recast recurs across lessons.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: Delayed independent retention is not yet established.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: Personally meaningful contexts reliably provide usable elicitation and personalization material.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: Engagement with those contexts is not proficiency evidence by itself.

acceptedLongitudinalSignals.signal: In Science, Gustavo can reach short connected explanations after rehearsal.
acceptedLongitudinalSignals.boundary: Independent retention and transfer still require verification.

authorizedCurrentState.learningFocus: Build lower-support retrieval and distinguish first-attempt performance from corrected or modeled output.
priorities: Stabilize did + base-form questions in meaningful Past Simple tasks.
Strengthen independent retrieval of irregular past forms.
Test delayed retrieval after corrective scaffolding instead of counting immediate repetition as mastery.
Use meaningful personal and school contexts to elicit language while keeping engagement separate from proficiency evidence.
Separate Science content knowledge from independent English control through low-support explanation tasks.

School-test results not supplied by the appropriate source.
Any learner-facing state built from unresolved source conflict.
